summary: Mostly not: most MAR settings left price where random entries would have, on 1h, 4h and daily. The result that holds up is on 1h: after price crossed down through 0.97 of its EMA 20, it beat random by 0.46% after 20 candles, without its strongest stretch and at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles. On daily the same dip did worse than random, by 4.12% after 20 days.

verdicts.use: Buying a dip to 0.97 of EMA 20 on 1h
verdicts.text: Beat random by 0.46% after 20 candles. It held without its strongest stretch and at 10, 20, 50 and 100 candles, and uptrends carry it.

verdicts.use: Buying a dip below EMA 20 on daily
verdicts.text: Worse than random after 20 days at both 0.99 and 0.97. Uptrends carry the loss. In downtrends it was the same as random.

verdicts.use: Riding a rising trend (Price / EMA 50 above 1.01)
verdicts.text: Beat random on 1h by 0.36%, at every horizon and without its strongest stretch. It was the same as random on 4h and fragile on daily.

verdicts.use: Shorting a stretch above EMA 20 (crosses up 1.03)
verdicts.text: Worse than random on 1h at every horizon and on all three coins. On 4h it was fragile pooled, but worse than random in uptrends.

verdicts.use: Buying a shallow dip (crosses down 0.99) with EMA, KAMA, ALMA or LSMA
verdicts.text: Same as random on 1h and 4h with EMA, KAMA, ALMA and LSMA. The one exception is LSMA on 1h, which is fragile and rests on one stretch.
Beat random on 1h only because of one entry on Feb 22, 2021, and only at 10 and 20 candles. Same as random on 4h and daily.

notes: On 1h, price crossing down through 0.97 of its EMA 20 gave 2,160 entries in 994 separate moves. Twenty candles later they were 0.46% ahead of random entries, above a luck band that tops out at 0.32%. BTC at 0.47% and ETH at 0.45% beat random on their own. SOL's 0.4% is fragile and rests on signals on May 16–18, 2021.

That 1h gap comes from uptrends, when the pair closed above its 200-day SMA. There the 0.97 dip beat random by 0.69%. In downtrends it was 0.09%, the same as random. The shallower cross down through 0.99 fires about three times as often and lands at -0.01%, the same as random.

The same dip reads the other way on daily. Crossing down through 0.97 of EMA 20 did 4.12% worse than random after 20 days, and stayed worse at 10, 50 and 100 days and without its strongest stretch. The 0.99 cross did 2.43% worse. In uptrends it was 4.68% worse, and in downtrends it was the same as random. On 4h the 0.97 dip was the same as random at 0.23%.

Price / EMA 50 above 1.01, rising 2% in 10 bars, beat random by 0.36% on 1h. It held at every horizon and without its strongest stretch, between Dec 31, 2020 and Jan 8, 2021. Uptrends carry it at 0.37%. Downtrends gave 0.17%, the same as random. SOL beat random at 0.47%, while BTC was the same as random. On 4h it was the same as random, and on daily its 4.13% is fragile and rests on the run between Jul 30 and Nov 9, 2021.

Shorting as price crossed up through 1.03 of EMA 20 did 0.54% worse than random on 1h, at every horizon and on BTC, ETH and SOL. Uptrends carry it at 0.59% worse. In downtrends it was fragile, resting on signals on Jan 13, 2023. On 4h, uptrends did 1% worse at every horizon, and downtrends were the same as random. Price kept rising after these stretches.

On 1h, the 0.97 cross below EMA 20 fits as a long DCA start condition beside an uptrend filter, since downtrends showed nothing. The bot's DCA and take profit still carry the deal. Do not move it to daily, where the same dip did worse than random. For a short bot, the cross up through 1.03 is a reason to stay out on 1h and 4h. The 0.99 crosses with any average, and the EMA 20 over EMA 50 cross, did no better than random, so leave them out of the timing.
